screens.name: My Work queue (rail + detail shell)
screens.route: /my-work (optional ?assessment=<id> deep link); wrapped in ProtectedRoute only, not RoleRoute (web/src/App.tsx:29-36)
screens.purpose: Single role-driven inbox listing every incident awaiting coordinator triage and every assessment step waiting on the signed-in user, with the selected item's work panel beside it.
roles: Any signed-in user can hit the route (ProtectedRoute, web/src/App.tsx:29-36); the queue itself renders only for hasWorkQueue() = isOperationalUser(): MAINTENANCE_COORDINATOR/MAINT_COORDINATOR, GEOTECH_OFFICE_CHIEF/OFFICE_CHIEF, GEOTECH_BRANCH_CHIEF/BRANCH_CHIEF, GEOTECH_ENGINEER/FIELD_WORKER, REVIEWER, ADMIN (web/src/utils/roleModel.ts:17-24,71-73; web/src/features/myWork/MyWorkPage.tsx:46,106)
MAINTENANCE_FIELD_WORKER/MAINTENANCE (maintenance-only) see the 'No workflow steps are assigned to your role' state (MyWorkPage.tsx:106-117)

Queue composition per role: coordinator/admin -> triage incidents (canTriage, MyWorkPage.tsx:59-61); office chief/admin -> office_chief queue + APPROVED (52,56); branch chief/admin -> branch_chief queue (53); engineer/admin -> DRAFT/REVISION_REQUESTED (54); everyone -> reviewer queue SUBMITTED (55); admin -> all SUBMITTED (57)
primaryTasks: See what is waiting on me and pick the next item
Act on the selected item (triage a field report or advance an assessment step)
Jump to the underlying incident / submission / map record when more context is needed

Assigned engineer (GEOTECH_ENGINEER/FIELD_WORKER matching assigned_engineer_user_id)/admin: create/fill submission and Submit for review at DRAFT/REVISION_REQUESTED (assessmentModel.ts:129-130)
Assigned REVIEWER/APPROVER (any role with an assignment)/admin: Request revision / Approve at SUBMITTED (assessmentModel.ts:131)
Anyone else in the queue sees 'No actions for your role on this step.' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:272)
primaryTasks: Perform the one workflow action the step is waiting on
Check the attached technical submissions and open the right one
See who is assigned and what happened so far

painPoints.issue: The nearest group is pre-selected as the default decision whenever any group is within range, biasing the coordinator toward association; 'Starts its own event' must be actively chosen

Fixed 380px map inside a scrollable modal inside a scroll-locked page: touch users fight nested scrolling and map gesture capture
Changing the radius can silently drop the user's selection (forces CREATE_NEW when the new radius returns nothing, or forces the already-associated group)
Nearby list is capped at 50 with no 'more results' indicator, and 'Starts its own event' is always the first row even when many groups exist
Fields fetched but never shown (requires_event_group_decision, is_permanent) — the UI cannot tell the coordinator whether a decision is even required

EventGroupAssociationDialog fetches requires_event_group_decision and is_permanent but never uses them (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:19-25); onContinueToTriage passes incidentId that the consumer ignores (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:65,237 vs IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:76). GraphicsLayer titles are set but no layer widget shows them (EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:47-49).

Duplicated helpers: assessmentStateLabel exists in both web/src/utils/roleModel.ts:81-93 and web/src/features/assessments/assessmentModel.ts:51-63; inputClass is defined separately in IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:25 and EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:50 with different content; the red status pill is hand-rolled in MyWorkPage.tsx:153 and TriageWorkItem.tsx:59 instead of reusing the toneClass badge in AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:64-77; the 'Next step' card is copied in TriageWorkItem.tsx:67-80 from AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:254-265; error-banner markup is repeated in MyWorkPage.tsx:127 and EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:174.

Two dialog header implementations: DialogShell (IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:27-55, text-lg title, p-5 panel) vs the hand-built header in EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:165-171 (text-base title, custom panelClassName) — same × button, different sizes and paddings.

Button styling is ad hoc per file: MyWorkPage.tsx:124 (px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium), TriageWorkItem.tsx:63 (px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold), AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:126-128 (btn/btnPrimary/btnGood, text-xs), IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:103-106 (py-2 text-sm), EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:208 (unique outlined-brand variant). The .btn-brand utility in web/src/index.css:87 is unused by this area. Primary/secondary/destructive semantics vary: 'Request revision' is a bordered button with red text (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:323), Approve/Finalize use --good fills, Resolve uses --good fill.

Vocabulary drift: the same pre-intake state is 'New report' (MyWorkPage.tsx:153), 'Awaiting triage' (TriageWorkItem.tsx:59) and 'Field report … not yet in the incident record' (TriageWorkItem.tsx:55); 'Disposition' vs 'decision' (IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:93,99,106); 'technical submission' vs 'GISA form' vs 'Submission' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:288,336,339); office shown as 'Office NORTH' in the rail but 'North GeoTech Office' in the panel (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434 vs 59-62,234); 'D7' vs 'District 7'; 'Reviewer' vs 'Assigned reviewers' (MyWorkPage.tsx:31; assessmentModel.ts:86).

Raw codes reach the UI: submission status badge prints the enum ('SUBMITTED', 'REVISION_REQUESTED') (web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx:14-15); reporter shows 'User #N' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:354); header shows role enums (AppShell.tsx:157); Event Group rows and popups lead with '#id' (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:195; EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:103,115).

Routing inconsistencies: /my-work is ProtectedRoute-only and self-gates with an empty state (App.tsx:29-36; MyWorkPage.tsx:106-117) while sibling operational pages use RoleRoute; RoleRoute denial redirects to /submissions (web/src/auth/RoleRoute.tsx:19), a page with no nav entry (AppShell.tsx:66-67); LoginPage hard-codes /my-work (LoginPage.tsx:28,42) while HomeRedirect chooses /my-work vs /incidents by role (App.tsx:175-178); legacy /projects and /projects/:id redirects remain (App.tsx:77-78,180-183).

Responsive pattern gaps: the only two-column breakpoint in the area is xl on My Work (MyWorkPage.tsx:136) and lg in the review dialog (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:177); everything else relies on flex-wrap. Fixed pixel sizes: rail max-h-[860px], map height 380, pipeline min-w-[74px], history max-h-[420px], list max-h-[52vh]. Mobile navigation is an inline card, not a drawer (AppShell.tsx:164). No touch-target sizing: most action buttons are text-xs/py-1.5 (~28-30px).

Accessibility gaps: active rail card has no aria-current/aria-pressed and the rail has no list semantics (MyWorkPage.tsx:139-170; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:447-449); error/notice/loading messages are not live regions (MyWorkPage.tsx:127-128,132,183; EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:174,176); selects and the notes textarea in the assessment panel have no labels (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:294,298-314,370-373); map container has aria-label on a div with no role (EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:129); disabled Record/Continue buttons give no reason (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:208,237). Strengths to keep: ModalDialog focus trap, Escape, focus restoration, scroll lock and data-dialog-initial-focus (web/src/ui/ModalDialog.tsx:43-110; IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:94).

Error surfacing: dialogs opened from TriageWorkItem report failures through onError to the page banner behind the overlay, and the dialog does not close, so the user may never see the message (TriageWorkItem.tsx:43-44; MyWorkPage.tsx:127). EventGroupAssociationDialog, by contrast, shows its own in-dialog banner (174) — two patterns in one flow.

Theming: map symbology uses hard-coded RGB arrays and rgb() legend swatches while the rest of the area uses --brand/--bad/--good tokens; the legend's 'New incident' swatch uses var(--bad) but the marker uses [209,75,84] (EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:22-25,131-133). AssessmentDetailPanel mixes inline style color-mix (254-262) with Tailwind arbitrary color-mix classes used everywhere else.

Consequential one-click actions without confirmation or required rationale across the area: Delegate, Assign engineer, Submit for review, Request revision (auto-fills 'Revision requested.'), Approve, Finalize (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:306,315,319,323-328); Record decision persists the Event Group association immediately (EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:140-146); Record triage decision defaults to Assessment required (TriageWorkItem.tsx:75).
